decisions.reason: The firm has already invested in the fifteen-day express program and publicly launched it, so commitment pressures make withdrawal unlikely despite only moderate visibility.
Strong public commitment through the homepage and European approval, coupled with high development and certification costs, makes dropping this product highly unlikely.
The dedicated website presence and multiple models reflect substantial sunk investment and public commitment, favoring continued support of the express delivery line.
Although its public visibility is lower, the fire and smoke protection door embodies invested development and safety expertise, leading the firm to persist.
